name: Drizzle ORM
solves: Provides a lightweight, type-safe TypeScript ORM that maps closely to SQL syntax, supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite across serverless and traditional runtimes with zero dependencies and minimal bundle size.
best_for: TypeScript-first projects that want SQL-like query building with full type safety
Serverless and edge deployments where bundle size and cold start time matter
Projects using multiple database providers (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) that want a unified ORM API
Teams that prefer writing queries close to raw SQL but with type inference and schema declarations in code
Applications targeting Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge Functions, or other edge runtimes where traditional ORMs fail
skip_when: You need a mature, battle-tested migration system with long production history (Prisma or Knex may be more proven)
Your team prefers ActiveRecord-style ORM patterns with rich model instances and lifecycle hooks
You are building a Python or non-JavaScript/TypeScript backend
You need extensive built-in support for MongoDB or other NoSQL databases
Your project is a simple script that only needs a raw query runner without schema management
